scope: Mutually exclusive MTF-02P/MTF-01P on the same adhesive tray. No printed or hardware change, no physical adhesive/holding-torque qualification.
intentional_changes: Centralize published optical sensor specifications in immutable profiles. One source key selects the installed device envelope, connection, listed mass and source evidence. Default remains MTF-02P.

Own sensor and own broad connector lane intentionally intersect this proxy; all external parts/reservations remain obstacles. Actual connected cable visibility is unverified.

Validate each profile at25attitudes on each host plus continuous external optical bounds, native registration, attachment and service checks. Substitute the same three reference objects in memory and exactly restore shapes, metadata, host and angles afterward.

Retain MTF02P native object IDs as stable slot identities. Labels, SensorModel and SensorProfileContract identify the current source-selected device; the temporary apply_profile probe does not update the released BOM.
